question.text: A Cat III AIF's Trustee is assessed under Section 161/164 as a:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.2.2, Trustees are assessed as 'representative assessee' under Section 161 (Determinate) or Section 164 (Indeterminate) of Income Tax Act. The Trap: Beneficial owner/direct payer don't capture the representative role. Cross-Exam Context: Core trust-taxation principle. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Document trustee's representative-assessee status clearly in annual returns.
